full_judgment: 17. In Commissioner of Income Tax Vs. Shuroji Ballav Das and Company (1962) 46. I.T.R. 144, the managing agent had given up 75% of its earning. The Income Tax Authorities assessed that the amount had already accrued to the assesses in the year of accounting notwithstanding that the assesses by subsequent agreement had altered the rate of commission to a lesser figure. The Indian Supreme Court took the view that the assessee had, in fact, received only the lesser amount in spite of the entries in the beck and this lesser amount alone was taxable. It observed:-
